items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I do John Pizzarelli when he uses a big band, we have a couple of things coming up next month

ctx.x: Wow. That’s great, you know. Most guys don’t think to do that.

No I did. I made a point out of that. There are some records that I played on that I probably don’t have but most of them I do have. The ones that were meaningful. I mean a lot of the schlock things I don’t even bother with. But these days, now I’m not going into the City on a regular basis, but what I do do still, at this point, and right now this is now November 2001, I still do pretty much all of Don Sebesky’s stuff. I do John Pizzarelli when he uses a big band, we have a couple of things coming up next month,…
regular basis. And on a regular basis means you do a Broadway show or you sub a Broadway show. I don’t do that anymore. But I do go in for dates and things.
